title: Order the pipeline: expansion MRR month over month
prompt: Finance wants expansion MRR: for accounts whose MRR increased from the prior month, the sum of that increase, by month. Put these blocks in the order they need to run.
grain: Ends at one row per month.

steps.label: Aggregate subscriptions to one row per account per month (MRR)
Apply LAG to get each account's MRR in the prior month
Filter to rows where MRR increased versus the prior month
Sum the positive deltas by month

explanation: LAG needs one row per account per month to look back a month, so aggregation has to happen first. Filtering to increases only makes sense once the delta (current vs. prior) exists, and summing by month comes last.
